scope: Six cross-domain settings, official candidates, target images/task queries/frozen teacher only; manual GT isolated after all outputs seal; seed0; all DEV.
motivation: Joint question-channel shift; V3 reward is No-safe but none of three fixed prefix videos exhibited conditional teacher skill or changed the question sequence.
three_candidate_components: Stable object identity plus reference-centered local state, retaining cross-candidate contrast.
Conditional feature-learning objective removing shared logit nuisance under explicit assumptions, with internal common-shift gauge fixing.
Teacher-anchored learned observer A and solver S, with paid fresh conditional-discrimination probes and matched frozen/raw controls.
ordinary_teaching: Prefer original single-candidate Yes/No protocol as a strong control. Native binary answer data exists in observation_design_prepare/full_collection; no invented cross-object joint answers.
explicit_modelling_assumption: Product of two binary opinions is factorized pseudo-supervision, not measured joint teacher evidence. Common query/view additive logit bias cancels in relative target; sampling weights and object-specific errors need separate audit.
required_fair_controls: Adequate ordinary direct binary soft/hard unit/confidence heads; all paid data and shared visual context; same fits/snapshots; frozen observer, learned observer, frozen solver feedback; representation/objective/observer factorial and fixed-question replay.
next_acceptance: Complete current six-setting joint study and independent aggregate reproduction; implement unified native-binary learner/observer and all-six raw plus dual CountMatched generation before any new GT evaluation; fresh matched cold deployment only if quality survives.
